subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Base Rate Neglect
description: A micro-lesson that makes Base Rate Neglect usable.

hook.text: A test is 99% accurate. You test positive. Most people assume 99% chance they're sick. They're wrong.

buildup.text: If the disease affects 1 in 10,000, most positives are false. The base rate matters enormously.

discovery.text: Base rate neglect: we focus on vivid details and ignore how common the condition really is.

twist.text: With a 1/10,000 base rate and 99% accuracy, your actual chance of being sick is under 1%.

climax.text: Before trusting a result, ask: how common is this in the population? The base rate changes everything.

quiz.question: What do people ignore in base rate neglect?
options: How common the condition is in the population
